<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F8FCFF"/>
  
  <!-- status bar -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="28" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="20" y="19" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
    <line x1="326" y1="17" x2="326" y2="12" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="331" y1="17" x2="331" y2="10" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="336" y1="17" x2="336" y2="8" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="350" cy="14" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="348" y1="16" x2="352" y2="12" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="363" y="8" width="21" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="365" y="10" width="15" height="8" rx="1.5" fill="#15451F"/>
    <rect x="385" y="12" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>

  <!-- onboarding header -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="28" width="390" height="58" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <polyline points="30,57 22,65 30,73" fill="none" stroke="#15451F" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="23" y1="65" x2="39" y2="65" stroke="#15451F" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="55" y="62" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="20px" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Set up your journey</text>
    <text x="55" y="78" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">Personalize your French lessons</text>
    <text x="356" y="66" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="16px" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">2/4</text>
  </g>

  <!-- progress -->
  <g>
    <rect x="16" y="99" width="358" height="10" rx="64" fill="#E5E5E5"/>
    <rect x="16" y="99" width="179" height="10" rx="64" fill="#00A47D"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="104" r="6" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#00A47D" stroke-width="3"/>
    <circle cx="30" cy="104" r="4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="284" cy="104" r="4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="360" cy="104" r="4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>

  <!-- title -->
  <g>
    <text x="195" y="153" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="26px" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Where are you headed?</text>
    <text x="195" y="179" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="16px" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">Tell us about your next adventure.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- destination card shadow -->
  <rect x="17" y="200" width="356" height="137" rx="14" fill="#D9D9D9" opacity="0.45"/>
  <g>
    <rect x="16" y="198" width="356" height="137" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E5E5" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="34" y="224" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="16px" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Your destination</text>
    <text x="34" y="244" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">Choose a place to focus your vocabulary.</text>
    <!-- french flag -->
    <rect x="34" y="260" width="57" height="43" rx="11" fill="#FF4B4B"/>
    <rect x="34" y="260" width="19" height="43" rx="8" fill="#1899D6"/>
    <rect x="53" y="260" width="19" height="43" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="72" y="260" width="19" height="43" rx="8" fill="#FF4B4B"/>
    <text x="105" y="279" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="18px" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">France</text>
    <text x="105" y="298" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">French selected</text>
    <polyline points="344,276 351,283 344,290" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- destination field -->
  <g>
    <text x="16" y="367" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="16px" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Specific destination</text>
    <rect x="16" y="376" width="358" height="54" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#9DAD88" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="39" cy="401" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="46" y1="408" x2="52" y2="414" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="65" y="407" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="17px" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Paris, France</text>
    <line x1="65" y1="416" x2="170" y2="416" stroke="#1899D6" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="350" cy="401" r="11" fill="#00A47D"/>
    <polyline points="344,401 348,405 356,396" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="16" y="449" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">You can change this anytime.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- trip timing -->
  <g>
    <text x="16" y="482" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="16px" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">When are you going?</text>
    <rect x="16" y="492" width="171" height="58" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#1899D6" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="42" cy="521" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#1899D6" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="42" y1="521" x2="42" y2="515" stroke="#1899D6" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="42" y1="521" x2="47" y2="524" stroke="#1899D6" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="61" y="517" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="16px" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">In 3 months</text>
    <text x="61" y="537" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">June 2026</text>
    <rect x="203" y="492" width="171" height="58" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E5E5" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="229" cy="521" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="248" y="527" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="16px" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">Not sure yet</text>
  </g>

  <!-- learning focus -->
  <g>
    <text x="16" y="581" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="16px" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">What will you use French for?</text>
    <rect x="16" y="591" width="358" height="42" rx="13" fill="#DDF4FF" stroke="#63C9F9" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="38" cy="612" r="10" fill="#1899D6"/>
    <polyline points="33,612 37,616 44,608" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="59" y="618" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="16px" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Travel and everyday conversations</text>
  </g>

  <!-- buttons -->
  <g>
    <rect x="16" y="647" width="358" height="48" rx="13" fill="#1899D6"/>
    <text x="195" y="677" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="16px" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Continue</text>
    <polyline points="250,668 257,672 250,676" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="16" y="702" width="358" height="30" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#9DAD88" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="195" y="722" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="16px" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Let’s Do It</text>
  </g>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="738" width="390" height="106" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="16" y1="738" x2="374" y2="738" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <!-- home -->
    <g>
      <polygon points="35,767 47,757 59,767" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <rect x="39" y="766" width="16" height="13" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="47" y="801" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="13px" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">Home</text>
    </g>
    <!-- lessons -->
    <g>
      <rect x="113" y="757" width="24" height="21" rx="3" fill="#DDF4FF" stroke="#1899D6" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="119" y1="763" x2="131" y2="763" stroke="#1899D6" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="119" y1="768" x2="131" y2="768" stroke="#1899D6" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="125" y="801" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="13px" font-weight="700" fill="#1899D6">Learn</text>
    </g>
    <!-- practice -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="203" cy="767" r="12" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <polygon points="203,758 206,765 214,766 208,771 210,778 203,774 196,778 198,771 192,766 200,765" fill="#FFC800"/>
      <text x="203" y="801" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="13px" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">Practice</text>
    </g>
    <!-- profile -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="292" cy="763" r="7" fill="#9DAD88"/>
      <ellipse cx="292" cy="776" rx="13" ry="7" fill="#9DAD88"/>
      <text x="292" y="801" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="13px" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">Profile</text>
    </g>
    <!-- more -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="350" cy="762" r="2.5" fill="#6F6F70"/>
      <circle cx="350" cy="769" r="2.5" fill="#6F6F70"/>
      <circle cx="350" cy="776" r="2.5" fill="#6F6F70"/>
      <text x="350" y="801" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="13px" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">More</text>
    </g>
    <line x1="0" y1="833" x2="390" y2="833" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <rect x="164" y="836" width="62" height="4" rx="2" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>
</svg>
